tools.name: get_protocol_status
tools.title: Get protocol status
tools.description: Which networks this server can reach, whether each Mesh Server is up, protocol totals (TVL, 24h volume, pools, fills) and this server's settings (default network, whether order creation is enabled). Call it first when unsure which network to use.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.title: Search tokens
tools.description: Find CashTokens by symbol, name or category id prefix, ordered by liquidity. Returns each token's category id (the identifier every other tool takes), decimals and price. Call this first when the user names a token by symbol.

params.name: query
params.description: Symbol, name or start of a category id. Omit to list the most liquid tokens.

params.name: limit
params.description: How many to return (default 10).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: get_prices
tools.title: Get USD prices
tools.description: Spot USD price and 24-hour change of BCH and the other majors the protocol tracks (BTC, ETH, SOL…). For a CashToken's price use search_tokens or get_quote.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: get_token_price_history
tools.title: Get token price history
tools.description: Price history of one CashToken, per whole token, in sats and USD. Only periods with trades have points.

params.name: token
params.description: The token: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: range
params.description: Time span (default 1D).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: get_quote
tools.title: Get a swap quote
tools.description: What a swap would return right now and the route the solver would take (Mesh pools, Cauldron, solver inventory or a split). Nothing is created. Quote before creating an order.

params.name: sellToken
params.description: Token to sell: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: buyToken
params.description: Token to buy: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: sellAmount
params.description: Amount to sell, as an integer string in base units: satoshis for BCH (1 BCH = 100000000), the smallest unit for tokens (see the token's decimals). Never a decimal number.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: get_orderbook
tools.title: Get the orderbook
tools.description: Aggregated depth of Mesh pool liquidity for a pair: price levels with the amount available at each, and the spread.

params.name: baseToken
params.description: First token of the pair: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: quoteToken
params.description: Second token of the pair: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: depth
params.description: Price levels per side (default 10).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: list_pairs
tools.title: List traded pairs
tools.description: Every pair with Mesh liquidity: pool count, TVL, volume, fees, best bid and ask, and depth. Prices are sats per token base unit.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: create_swap_order
tools.title: Create a swap order
tools.description: Prepare a swap order: market (fill now at the quote, within slippage), limit (fill at or above a price you set) or dutch (price falls from a start to a minimum over the duration). Returns a covenant address and how to fund it. NOTHING MOVES until the maker funds the covenant from their own wallet; this server holds no key. Once funded, a solver fills the order and the maker address receives the bought asset; if it does not fill in time the funds return to the maker. Confirm the tokens, amounts and maker address with the user before calling.

params.name: makerAddress
params.description: The user's own P2PKH cashaddr (bitcoincash:q… on mainnet, bchtest:q… on chipnet). The fill and any refund are paid to it. Ask the user; never invent one.

params.name: sellToken
params.description: Token to sell: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: buyToken
params.description: Token to buy: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: sellAmount
params.description: Amount to sell, as an integer string in base units: satoshis for BCH (1 BCH = 100000000), the smallest unit for tokens (see the token's decimals). Never a decimal number.

params.name: orderType
params.description: market (default), limit or dutch.

params.name: minBuyAmount
params.description: Least the maker accepts for the whole order, in base units of the buy token. Required for limit and dutch; for market it replaces the slippage calculation.

params.name: startBuyAmount
params.description: Dutch only: the amount asked at the start, in base units of the buy token (default: the live quote).

params.name: slippageBps
params.description: Market only: how far below the quote the order may fill, in basis points (default 100 = 1%).

params.name: durationSec
params.description: How long the order stays open, in seconds (60 to 604800; default 3600). Unfilled funds return to the maker after it.

params.name: acceptPriceDeviation
params.description: Set true to create the order even though its minimum is far below the live quote. Only after the user has confirmed the price.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Status of one swap order: whether it is funded, filled or refunded, with the transaction id and explorer link.

params.name: orderId
params.description: The order id returned by create_swap_order (intent_…).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: Swap orders of one maker, newest first, optionally filtered by status or type. TWAP slices appear as orders with a twapOrderId.

params.name: makerAddress
params.description: The maker's P2PKH cashaddr or 40-hex public key hash.

params.name: status
params.description: Only orders in this status.

params.name: type
params.description: limit, or dutch (market orders and TWAP slices are dutch).

params.name: limit
params.description: How many to return (default 20).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: request_refund
tools.title: Request a refund
tools.description: Ask the server to return a funded, unfilled order to its maker now. Works only after the order's deadline; before it, the answer says when it becomes eligible. The refund can only pay the maker. Refunds also happen automatically.

params.name: orderId
params.description: The order id (intent_…).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: quote_twap
tools.title: Quote a TWAP order
tools.description: Estimate a TWAP: one sale split into equal slices over time, each filled separately to reduce price impact. Returns the estimated output per slice and in total. Nothing is created.

params.name: sellToken
params.description: Token to sell: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: buyToken
params.description: Token to buy: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: totalSellAmount
params.description: Total amount to sell across all slices, as an integer string in base units: satoshis for BCH (1 BCH = 100000000), the smallest unit for tokens (see the token's decimals). Never a decimal number.

params.name: numSlices
params.description: Number of slices (default 4, max 48).

params.name: intervalSec
params.description: Seconds between slice starts (default 600).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: create_twap_order
tools.title: Create a TWAP order
tools.description: Prepare a TWAP: the sale is split into equal slices, each its own price-protected covenant that opens at its start time. Returns one funding output per slice; the maker funds them all in ONE transaction from their own wallet. NOTHING MOVES until then; this server holds no key. Slices cannot be cancelled early: a slice that does not fill in its window is refunded to the maker. Confirm the details with the user before calling.

params.name: makerAddress
params.description: The user's own P2PKH cashaddr. Fills and refunds are paid to it. Ask the user; never invent one.

params.name: sellToken
params.description: Token to sell: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: buyToken
params.description: Token to buy: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: totalSellAmount
params.description: Total amount to sell across all slices, as an integer string in base units: satoshis for BCH (1 BCH = 100000000), the smallest unit for tokens (see the token's decimals). Never a decimal number.

params.name: numSlices
params.description: Number of slices (default 4, max 48).

params.name: intervalSec
params.description: Seconds between slice starts (default 600).

params.name: minBuyAmountPerSlice
params.description: Least the maker accepts for ONE slice, in base units of the buy token (default: the live quote for one slice less slippageBps).

params.name: slippageBps
params.description: How far below the per-slice quote a slice may fill, in basis points (default 200 = 2%). Ignored when minBuyAmountPerSlice is given.

params.name: sliceWindowSec
params.description: How long each slice stays fillable (default: the larger of intervalSec and 3600; minimum 1800 because chain time moves a block at a time).

params.name: acceptPriceDeviation
params.description: Set true to create the order even though its minimum is far below the live quote. Only after the user has confirmed the price.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: get_twap_order
tools.title: Get a TWAP order
tools.description: Progress of a TWAP order: overall status and every slice (when it starts, whether it filled or was refunded).

params.name: orderId
params.description: The TWAP order id returned by create_twap_order.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: list_pools
tools.title: List Mesh pools
tools.description: Mesh liquidity pools: each is one LP's covenant quoting a fixed price with a fee. Filter by token or owner. Prices are sats per token base unit.

params.name: token
params.description: Only pools trading this token: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: owner
params.description: Only pools of this LP: a P2PKH cashaddr (bitcoincash:q… / bchtest:q…) or its 40-hex public key hash.

params.name: status
params.description: active (default): has liquidity; exhausted: empty but open; closed: withdrawn; all.

params.name: sort
params.description: Order, highest first (default value; volume and fees are 7-day).

params.name: limit
params.description: How many to return (default 15).

params.name: offset
params.description: How many to skip, for paging (default 0).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: get_pool
tools.title: Get a Mesh pool
tools.description: One pool in detail: price, fee, reserves, its UTXOs, lifetime stats, and the other pools of the same strategy.

params.name: address

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: get_pool_activity
tools.title: Get pool activity
tools.description: Ledger events of one pool, or the latest across all pools when no address is given: fills, deposits and withdrawals, newest first.

params.name: address

params.name: type
params.description: Only this event type (all-pools view only).

params.name: limit
params.description: How many to return (default 20).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

params.name: limit

params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: list_strategy_templates
tools.title: List strategy templates
tools.description: The liquidity strategies an LP can deploy (fixed price, spread, grid, ladders, stable pair…): what each does, what it earns, its risk, and the exact parameters it takes. Read this before previewing a strategy.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: suggest_strategy_params
tools.title: Suggest strategy parameters
tools.description: Market context for a template's tokens (Cauldron reference, best Mesh bid and ask, mid price) and parameters suggested around the mid. Deposits are left for the LP to choose.

params.name: template
params.description: Template id from list_strategy_templates (e.g. grid).

params.name: token
params.description: The token, for single-token templates: 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: tokenA
params.description: First token (stable-pair): 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: tokenB
params.description: Second token (stable-pair): 'BCH', a token symbol, or a CashToken category id (64 hex characters). A symbol shared by several tokens is refused; pass the category id then.

params.name: tokens
params.description: Tokens of a multi-pair template (1 to 3).

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: preview_strategy
tools.title: Preview a strategy
tools.description: Compute the pools a template would create for these parameters: each pool's address, the deposit it needs, and its price against the market. Nothing is created and nothing moves. To deploy, the LP funds every pool in ONE transaction from their own wallet (in the web app, or with their own tooling) and then registers it.

params.name: template
params.description: Template id from list_strategy_templates.

params.name: owner
params.description: The LP who will own the pools: a P2PKH cashaddr (bitcoincash:q… / bchtest:q…) or its 40-hex public key hash.

params.name: params
params.description: Template parameters, keyed as list_strategy_templates describes them (e.g. { token, lowSatsPerToken, highSatsPerToken, rungs, feeBps, depositSats }). Token fields take category ids. Prices are sats per token base unit; amounts are integer strings in base units.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: register_strategy
tools.title: Register a deployed strategy
tools.description: Ask the server to index a strategy the LP has ALREADY deployed on chain. The server recomputes the pool addresses from the template and parameters, finds them in the deploy transaction and verifies each on chain. The app does this itself; use it for deployments made with other tooling.

params.name: template
params.description: Template id used for the deployment.

params.name: owner
params.description: The LP who owns the pools: a P2PKH cashaddr (bitcoincash:q… / bchtest:q…) or its 40-hex public key hash.

params.name: params
params.description: Template parameters, keyed as list_strategy_templates describes them (e.g. { token, lowSatsPerToken, highSatsPerToken, rungs, feeBps, depositSats }). Token fields take category ids. Prices are sats per token base unit; amounts are integer strings in base units.

params.name: txid
params.description: The deploy transaction id.

params.name: replaces
params.description: Id of the strategy this one rebalanced, if any.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

params.name: owner

params.name: limit

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: find_idle_liquidity
tools.title: Find idle liquidity
tools.description: What an LP holds that is not working: pools left one-sided after the price moved, pools priced far from the market, exhausted pools, and loose coins in the wallet. Each item has a reason and a value.

params.name: owner
params.description: The LP: a P2PKH cashaddr (bitcoincash:q… / bchtest:q…) or its 40-hex public key hash.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).

tools.name: plan_recycle
tools.title: Plan a recycle
tools.description: Plan one transaction that closes idle pools and reopens their liquidity around the current price. Returns what to close, what to open, and what the wallet adds or gets back. Nothing moves: the LP signs it in the web app.

params.name: owner
params.description: The LP: a P2PKH cashaddr (bitcoincash:q… / bchtest:q…) or its 40-hex public key hash.

params.name: items
params.description: Ids from find_idle_liquidity to recycle (default: all).

params.name: spreadBps
params.description: Distance of the new buy and sell prices from the mid, in basis points.

params.name: feeBps
params.description: Fee of the new pools, in basis points.

params.name: network
params.description: BCH network. chipnet is the test network. Defaults to the server default (see get_protocol_status).
